[[File:Cave goblin guard chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Cave goblin guards''' are [[cave goblin]]s found in [[Dorgesh-Kaan mine|its mines]].

They are non-[[aggressiveness|aggressive]] unless a player attacks a [[cave goblin miner]]. If a cave goblin miner is attacked, the guard (if near) will come to his aid.

They can be of some profit to players as their drops can be sold to the nearby [[Dorgeshuun]] store. These goblins can only be accessed by completing the [[members]]-only [[Lost Tribe]] quest.

These goblins also guard the entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan.
